title: DeletePipelineStepResponse
description: DELETE /api/pipeline-steps/:id response (HEL-906 cycle 7, task 3.2). `removedTailStepCount` is the splice-on-delete report: the count of TAIL descendant steps removed outright (beyond the head child promoted onto the deleted step's own slot) when the deleted step was a branch point. `0` for the common case (deleting a trunk step, or a childless tail leaf) -- only a step with multiple children can ever remove more than the target itself.
